title: Flowers for Algernon
author: Daniel Keyes
current_text: Flowers for Algernon was banned in Plant City, Florida, in 1976; explicit, distasteful love scenes were cited among the reasons for opposition. Flowers for Algernon was banned in Emporium, Pennsylvania, in 1977. Flowers for Algernon was banned from the Glen Rose (Arkansas) High School library in 1981. Flowers for Algernon was challenged by Oberlin (Ohio) High School for its “distasteful love scenes.” Flowers for Algernon was challenged by Glenrock (Wyoming) High School for its “distasteful love scenes.”

sources.title: Bulletin 43 over censored books in the USA

sources.quote:
Flowers for Algernon
ISBN: 0156030306
Nebula Award winner for Best Science Fiction Novel in 1966 the book has been has been banned in Plant City, Florida; Emporium, Pennsylvania; and Glen Rose (Arkansas) High School. It has been challenged by Oberlin (Ohio) and Glenrock (Wyoming) High Schools for its "distasteful love scenes."
